caseName: Democratic Party of the United States v. Wisconsin ex rel. La Follette
caseNameFull: Democratic Party of the United States of America v. Wisconsin ex rel. La Follette

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Wis. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 448 U. S. 909.] Motion of the Democratic Conference for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of appellees for divided argument granted. Request for additional time for oral argument denied.
